documents.shelfmark: Seven gold bars, photographs and transcription on McCurley's IACR page (iacr.org/misc/china)

transcription.source: McCurley's transcription, checked against the fifteen IACR photographs
transcription.notes: 16 distinct strings of 8-25 letters in corpus.py; --measure --letters on corpus.py counts the string labels too (315), so the NOTES count is used.

system.summary: Constructed filler: about ten of every letter of the alphabet dealt into sixteen strings; no message.
system.notes: Chi-squared 1.251 on 25 df against uniform; 0 of 200,000 random strings as uniform.

prior_solution.where: Pelling and Bret Bowen noted the flat distribution; Schmeh/Pelling documentary case against the 1933 date

conditions.human_role: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login with privileges and passed its session cookie (from the browser developer tools) to the model, set up Claude Code with Fable 5.1 or Opus 5, and posed the problem with /goal; occasionally offered encouragement or chose which of the model-identified leads to pursue. No target-specific intervention recorded.

solution.what: Letter counts, IC 0.035, chi-squared against uniform 1.251 with Monte Carlo null.
Schmeh Top 50 and Pelling: anachronisms (Boeing 247, simplified characters, 1948) date the bars after 1933.
Transcription checked against the fifteen IACR photographs.

outcome.notes: Two independent lines (statistics, object dating) agree.
